  PROBLEM: The step's env block does not set PR_NUMBER, but the sourced script review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_protected_conflict.sh and the handoff script it sources both expect PR_NUMBER to be set.
  WHY: The protected conflict handoff script echoes AUTOFIX_GATE_CLAUDE_FIXER_PROTECTED_CONFLICT pr=${PR_NUMBER:-} which will produce malformed log output (pr= instead of pr=42). The handoff script review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh uses ${PR_NUMBER} in multiple places including the CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF log line and comment body construction. Without PR_NUMBER, the handoff comment will be incomplete or incorrect, and the log output will be unparseable. The test test_fallback_step_script_posts_the_protected_handoff explicitly sets PR_NUMBER: "42" in its environment, confirming the script expects this variable.
